I stayed at Rammos Hotel in Bodrum and honestly I can’t recommend it enough. I booked it because I needed a quiet break to decompress and relax. As it wasn’t really the season yet, I expected things to be limited because of the weather. But wow, they completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel so welcomed, they greeted me with flowers and a traditional drink for their 4th anniversary, which instantly set the tone for the stay. I was travelling solo so I was a bit nervous, but every member of staff made me feel so comfortable and cared for that it genuinely felt like I had my own little community there. I even stayed at another hotel afterwards and instantly missed Rammos because the hospitality and care were unmatched. Because there were only a few guests staying, it made the experience even more special. Seeing the same familiar faces every day made it feel like home in the best way. It honestly felt euphoric, completely detached from busy everyday life and like stepping into another world where everything slows down and people genuinely want you to relax and enjoy yourself. Seyda, Marvin, Burak and all the staff were amazing (sorry if I missed names). We shared many heartwarming moments that I’ll always remember. One of the biggest highlights was the spa. Malik and Pho were incredible and paid so much attention to my needs. I had hammam treatments, sauna sessions, facials, herbal teas and some of the best massages I’ve ever had. They even assessed my body, explained my tension and gave advice on how to improve it properly. You can tell they genuinely care about healing and wellness. Because it was off-season there wasn’t a breakfast buffet, but honestly I loved the personalised experience even more. Every morning they asked what I wanted and somehow brought sooo much food with endless options. I left breakfast full every single day. The hotel itself is beautiful. So aesthetic, peaceful and healing! Every corner felt calming and luxurious without being overwhelming. Also massive appreciation for the Marea restaurant and Tarik, who was so kind and attentive. He recommended an amazing dish and even helped remove the fish scales for me without hesitation. Such a thoughtful gesture that really reflected the hospitality throughout the whole hotel. Overall, this trip gave me exactly what I needed and more. I arrived stressed and exhausted and left feeling lighter, relaxed and genuinely happy. Even though it wasn’t peak season, the experience still felt luxurious, personal and unforgettable. I would 100% recommend Rammos Hotel to anyone wanting a peaceful getaway in Bodrum. I can’t wait to come back. Thank you so much to the whole Rammos team!!

First things first; this hotel is not located right in the shore, there is a very active road passing by between the hotel and the beach. A tunnel or an easy access footbridge would have been nice but there is only a steep and very high pedestrian overpass has been built by local government which is practically useless. You gotta be really careful when you try to cross the road. There are not enough parking space available and your car most likely ends up parked alongside the road side. Most of the evenings we have experienced smell of sewage. Also on few nights there was a very loud music originated from the hotel right next to the premises. In general Turgutreis/Akyarlar area has relatively high waves due to its windy nature. Its often more calm in morning. Beach side is not that quiet because of the active road passing by just right beside. There is no elevator in 3 floor buildings. You should take this into account. Hotel rooms are clean, being serviced everyday. Breakfast is served well with great selection. Gym and spa is relatively small but still works. Hotel also has a nice swimming pool. They have electricity generators in case of blackouts. They also have only 1 fast charger available for electric only cars. Their waterfront restaurant starts serving after 7 PM, and have great selection of sea food.

We had a really nice time at Rammos Hotel. The spa was fantastic – definitely worth a visit! Also, the water sports are very expensive, so keep that in mind if you’re planning to try them. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend it, especially for the spa and the poolside/beachside atmosphere.

This bohemian beauty of a hotel was absolutely fantastic. A little piece of heaven. Very high quality. New hotel. As you enter the hotel with a taxi, you are welcomed with a friendly greeting. Very professional and warm service from all the staff. The rooms are immaculate. We had a sea view which was absolutely fabulous. Lovely little details in the room as well including a bed menu which advises you that the pillows were made of feathers and were changed every day. Also, the bathroom shower gel and shampoo were just that little bit higher quality than I was getting in other areas in Bodrum. Air conditioning is superb as you are hit with a wall of cold air when you enter the room. It was my girlfriends birthday during my visit and they looked after my girlfriend with a fabulous cake, and Tiffany coloured balloons and a singalong at the restaurant. The swimming pool is very chic as well and the service around the pool is great. On one hot day, the staff came around and gave us all ice towels by the pool. You can also head to the beach which is for the hotel visitors and the sun sets over the sea rather than the mountain if you know what I mean, and I love that. One of my favourite sunsets on the whole Bodrum peninsula. Fantastic level of cocktails, we mainly had Aperol Spritz and Negronis and Gin and Tonics which were top level. The breakfast area serves very tasty mainly Turkish foods. Some other hotels in Bodrum serve fairly average Turkish cheese for example, but I could taste the quality here as I have been eating Turkish cheese all my life. There is also a restaurant in the evenings by the sea and we ate freshly caught octopus which was a dream. The restaurant attracts mainly a Turkish crowd of locals. We also had a beautiful salmon teriyaki dish on one night which I can still taste now. After 11pm, the DJ came out and started playing some Turkish music and several diners were dancing on the beach under the half moon. The area is still developing and there are some construction sites nearby and they will start construction again in the autumn. It means over the coming years, there will be more and more people in the area. There is no ATM near the hotel or a market at the moment. The area is quite quiet at the moment, but you can take a 10 minute taxi for £5 to Turgutreis and this is a thriving market town day or night. Or you can walk 30 minutes down the road and get to Fener beach during the day which is a very busy public beach with sands. The cocktails and food are quite expensive for Bodrum, but they are the same as London prices, so fine for me and you need to maintain the high prices to maintain the high quality. What the hotel could do with is some more visitors / tourists. It’s a new hotel at the moment and not that well known. The high quality is right there and it now needs some visitors.
